overview: Settings is at the bottom of your profile menu. Everything here is about your own account, whichever company you may be acting for.

rules: If you skip this, the app asks for your number the first time you apply for a job, ask for mentoring or send an enquiry.
To change the number later, select **Edit** on the same row.
What you posted for others, such as discussions and reviews, stays after you delete your account, without your name.
